annotation.title_clean: A Call to the State of Peru to Request Observer Status on the Council of Europe Steering Committee for New and Emerging Digital Technologies (CDNET) and Sign and Ratify the International Treaty on AI, Human Rights, Democracy, and the Rule of Law
annotation.title_en: A Call to the State of Peru to Request Observer Status on the Council of Europe Steering Committee for New and Emerging Digital Technologies (CDNET) and Sign and Ratify the International Treaty on AI, Human Rights, Democracy, and the Rule of Law
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Center for AI and Digital Policy (CAIDP)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: CAIDP letter urging Peru to seek observer status on the Council of Europe's CDNET and to sign and ratify the CoE Framework Convention on AI. It reviews Peru's AI law, regulation, and strategies, outlines the treaty's principles and safeguards, and argues for binding human-rights protections. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Peru should request observer status on CoE CDNET.
Peru should sign and ratify the CoE AI Framework Convention.
Peru's Law 31814 and Decree 115-2025-PCM provide a foundation for AI governance.
Peru would benefit from binding human-rights obligations, independent oversight, and redress mechanisms.
The treaty requires impact assessments, transparency, contestability and notice of AI interaction.
